sentiment.rationale: This is a pre-earnings digest, so the score reflects how stretched or depressed market expectations are heading into the print. This suggests the bar has been lowered somewhat, but the wide dispersion and negative revision also indicate elevated risk of a miss, leading to a mildly bearish score.
